translation.english_title: O realm of love, O new dream (sorrow)

english_lines: O realm of love, O new dream — O blissful flame
That dwells in the heart, come running.
notes: The opening deliberately matches song 014 because the Tamil reprises the same lines; the English does not vary the wording merely for novelty.

english_lines: When I see the great cloud roaming the sky...
notes: The cloud/plumage image is kept aligned with song 014 while preserving the source ellipses and sorrow-song context.

english_lines: O great gem born of love...
You are the treasure of a blissful life,
O song that drifts upon the breeze,
To behold the boundary of bliss,
In sorrow, let us sleep in the lap.
notes: `கானம்` is retained as song, so `தென்றலில் வீசும் கானமே` remains an image of song moving on the breeze rather than a generic `sweet breeze`.
The final Tamil line does not name whose lap; the English preserves that omission instead of inventing a possessor.

translator_notes: This source is a sorrow-version related to song 014. Repeated lines retain repeated English so the relationship between the two songs remains audible.
The source provides no separate singer line; no performer identity is inferred.
This is a literary source-faithful translation, not a singable adaptation.
